summary: More community.general deprecations: oci_vcn and the oneandone module utils and modules, whose API endpoint no longer resolves, all removed in 13.0.0.
questions: Why are the oneandone modules deprecated?

answer_card.title: community.general oneandone modules deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed in community.general 13.0.0:

- `oci_vcn`
- `oneandone` module utils and `oneandone_firewall_policy`, `oneandone_load_balancer`, `oneandone_monitoring_policy`, `oneandone_private_network`, `oneandone_public_ip`, because **DNS no longer resolves** their API endpoint.
